digest.component_or_area: e2 plan-review gate measurement and defect detection
propositions: Seeded-defect mutant corpus must contain at least 10 mutants per class (1–4) and 5 for class 5, each paired with an unmodified control, drawn from cleanly-closed real plans and carrying pair_id, defect_class, role, source_ticket_id, plan_text, children, and mutation metadata.

Pure counting helpers classify_pair and run_validity must correctly handle INDETERMINATE verdicts (mapped to false negatives not false positives), multi-criteria set-intersection attribution, and enforce an INDETERMINATE run-validity cap of 0.20.
Store-isolation mechanism must use git clone --local --branch tickets with standalone .git directory to ensure mutation commits never contaminate the real .tickets-tracker.

The live ~100-run LLM batch baseline is permanently rejected on cost and superseded by story d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder, which accumulates detection and blocking-FP signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.

Deterministic harness components (mutant assembly, thresholds, counting helpers, emit_baseline guard, and golden/synthetic tests) are built and unit-tested as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 but intentionally not landed on main.
